images.caption: Front facade of the David I. and Christine Weisblat house, Galesburg, MI

place.source_title: Weisblat House, The Acres (Galesburg Country Homes)

brief: Wright-designed Usonian house of 1951 in the Acres cooperative: a one-storey house of patterned concrete block and wood with a low, broad-eaved roof, clerestory windows, a carport and a wooded setting (west elevation view).

floors: W W W W W W W
facade.notes: the Weisblat House (Galesburg MI, 1951), a Wright Usonian: walls of textured concrete block, long glass walls of wood doors, a low hipped roof with wide red-painted eaves, a curved block retaining wall; in woods on a slope

why.note: a Wright Usonian of the Galesburg Country Homes co-op: block houses the owners built
